candidates.title: Defer sign-in after pet adoption
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience immediate pet customization before account creation.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning before they see value, with high mean duration (567s).

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Deferring sign-in lets users experience value before committing, directly targeting a 27.1% dropoff.

candidates.title: Desktop controls quick-start guide screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated interactive desktop controls guide screen right before home intro explaining how to summon, hide, and talk to your pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding completes, and finish dropoff is high (35.2%).

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Use system tray controls to summon, hide, feed, or chat with your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new controls guide screen before home intro.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support tickets and 35.2% finish dropoff, though adding a screen adds slight friction.

candidates.title: Grid layout redesign with visual pet choices
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend with a 2-column visual grid component featuring playful selection cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high dropoff rate (39.1%) and a long mean duration of 1017 seconds, showing choice paralysis during pet picking.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop readiness checker flow in waiting screen
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic desktop readiness checker with live progress indicator and desktop tips carousel.
candidates.why: Waiting step has an extreme mean time of 2336s, and support receives complaints that pets do not show up on desktop or app stalls.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop
waiting.body: We are calibrating your pet screen coordinates and checking desktop overlay permissions.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of waiting screen maintaining wait status function.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme mean wait time (2336s) and explicit stall complaints with interactive feedback.

candidates.title: Cloud account safety and persistence guarantee
candidates.change: Prominently display account save guarantees on the sign-in screen assuring users their pets are securely backed up to the cloud.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating account anxiety.

sign_in.headline: Save & Restore Your Pet Anytime
sign_in.body: Sign in to securely cloud-sync your pet data and prevent lost progress across sessions.
sign_in.hint: Your pet customization and stats will be linked safely to your cloud account.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on sign-in screen without violating fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy change backed by 8 support complaints regarding account anxiety.

candidates.title: Live waiting time estimate & completion alerts
candidates.change: Add time estimate indicators, notification prompts, and desktop readiness tips to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home waiting median is 201s and mean is 2336s, creating dropoff (18.7%) due to uncertain loading times.

components.label: What to expect on your desktop

guard.reason: Valid configuration additions to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long median/mean loading times on home step to set user expectations.

candidates.title: Clear path selection copy & time expectation
candidates.change: Clarify the path options with distinct copy contrasting fast pre-made pet selection against custom photo generation.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s and conversion drops 23.8%, suggesting confusion over path differences.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Pet
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-play pet companion in seconds, or upload photos to build a custom pet.
choose_path.hint: Preset pets take 10 seconds; custom pet photo upload takes ~1 minute.

guard.reason: text in 'choose_path.hint' has characters outside the allowed set: ['~']

candidates.title: Spotlight layout for home welcome screen
candidates.change: Switch home_intro layout to spotlight with a mascot visual component and direct call-to-action button.
candidates.why: 35.2% of users drop off at finish step despite reaching the home screen.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Look at the bottom right corner of your desktop screen to find your pet active and waiting.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Aims at high finish dropoff (35.2%), but lacks direct support mail alignment.

candidates.title: Photo upload guidance & fallback advice
candidates.change: Add clear photo requirements and fallback tips to the upload_photos screen to prevent custom pet generation errors.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect during adoption step.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Photos for Best Pet Results
upload_photos.body: Upload well-lit front-facing images so your pet renders accurately on your desktop.
upload_photos.hint: If generation takes too long, you can select from our preset avatars at any time.

guard.reason: Valid photo upload guidance copy added to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest dropoff step (39.1%) backed by explicit photo upload error tickets.

candidates.title: Story scroll layout for app intro
candidates.change: Apply story_scroll layout to the story screen with contextual onboarding hints to engage users early.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s and loses 23.8% of users.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Workspace Buddy
story.body: Your desktop pet lives alongside your open windows, cheering you on throughout your work day.
story.hint: Scroll down or press continue to select your pet companion.

guard.reason: Valid layout and text update on story screen while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Helps high early mean time on initial step, but low overall funnel friction.

Cloud account safety and persistence guarantee
Story scroll layout for app intro

decisions.title: Desktop readiness checker flow in waiting screen
Cloud account safety and persistence guarantee
Story scroll layout for app intro

shipped: Story scroll layout for app intro
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for all specific kinds of change (adoption/notification, choose_path/hint, home/new_flow, sign_in/incentive) because each has only been tested once.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
